requirements.text: A deterministic model, recorded live under a fake clock (with injections) and replayed simulated, makes the same decisions: replay returns ok: true.
A model that decides anything with Math.random() instead of the sim's seeded random is caught: replay returns ok: false with the mismatch located.
The study never asks the clinic for an impossible timing or for more than maxMornings (and never more than the manager's five), and always returns a well-formed report.
Over many clinics the 1 - alpha interval holds the true mean difference 90-99% of the time at alpha 0.05, and the estimate's mean error is under a minute.
The verdict follows the interval: within +-2 inclusive -> reads true; else wholly above 0 -> long; else wholly below 0 -> short; else cannot tell.
Same seed on the same clinic gives the same report; the controller, recorded and replayed through the harness against a twin clinic, matches.
Change one implementing file: exactly the evidence that depended on it drops out of filter(); change nothing: nothing drops.
requirements.json and links.json describe the project; node test.mjs exits 0 and writes evidence.json stamped by Fresh; README.md and LETTER.md exist.
